guiReload.description: Queue a model load through the Scene Controls request path

guiSampleModel.description: Select a discovered Sample model by its UI label

guiUnload.description: Queue Unload model through the Scene Controls request path

guiWaitForLoad.description: Set false to render the pending GUI model request without settling it; requires a GUI model action

bimSelectedObject.description: Select a BIM object through the browser/viewport selection path

ddgiIntensity.description: Set the DDGI output multiplier on the named frame

ddgiFitProbes.description: Queue a one-shot scene fit through the DDGI control path; does not enable GI

physicsAttach.description: Attach or replace a box on physicsNode or selected BIM/USD product; empty is inert

physicsAction.description: One-shot physics action after attachment and settled model changes; empty is inert

physicsNode.description: Explicit primary scene-node attachment/detach target, otherwise use current auxiliary selection

physicsJointMotorVelocity.description: Update the selected joint velocity motor without reanchoring

expectMaterialTextureFailure.description: Capture automation only. Requires materialTextureEdit; true requires the same backend action to throw, records its error and continues for after-failure captures. Unexpected success remains fatal.

expectMaterialRetirementFailure.description: Capture automation only. Requires materialRetirement; true requires the ordinary backend action to reject, logs the bounded reason and continues for actual after-failure captures. Unexpected success remains fatal.

expectResourceRetirementFailure.description: Requires resourceRetirement. True requires the ordinary backend action to reject; unexpected success is fatal.

animationPlaying.description: Resume or pause the selected glTF clip; use a separate event from scene/history/physics mutations.

animationClip.description: Select a glTF clip, or -1 to restore authored rest. May share an event with animationTime/animationPlaying only.

animationTime.description: Seek in seconds using binary64 precision. May share an event with animationClip/animationPlaying only.

objectScale.description: Interpolated per-axis multipliers of the captured authored basis. Each axis must keep its sign across adjacent keys; runtime validation enforces this relationship.

cameraSelection.description: Select an active authored camera by exact source node index or unique node name, or return to the viewport camera. Selection does not edit a camera definition or add history.

cameraPose.description: Write this frame's free viewport pose to one active authored camera-bearing node. Keep its lens and sibling poses, use parent-relative local conversion and ordinary Undo/Redo/save. Dispatch after the current camera track; selected-node pose animation rejects.

cameraProjection.description: Commit one undoable authored camera lens edit using the ordinary editor backend. FOV is radians; null omits only perspective aspectRatio/zfar. Shared camera definitions affect every source node using them. Changed animated fields reject.

resourceRetirement.description: Delete a currently unused catalog row and its proved orphan resources. Undo and redo use sceneHistory. Expected identities are guards, never ownership capabilities.

materialRetirement.description: Delete an unused arbitrary runtime material using its explicit source pair (-1 means runtime-only). Undo and redo use sceneHistory. Runtime audits every retained reference and publication owner.

materialBinding.description: One-shot primitive material assignment or duplication. Assign supplies the explicit destination pair; makeUnique supplies the current selected pair and may name the duplicate. The backend proves current binding/catalog identities and source/resource provenance before publication. Runtime requires JSON integer tokens, rejecting floats including 1.0.

materialTextureSampler.description: Exact glTF sampler policy. Omitted filters use glTF defaults; unsupported enums are rejected rather than silently normalized.

materialTextureMapping.description: Omitted leaves are untouched. Null resets the known source leaf. Channel edits additionally require a compatible live legacy slot; standard channels are fixed.

materialTextureEdit.description: One atomic source texture/resource transaction. Resource IDs are authored catalog identities, not GPU handles. Live owner, role, mapping, capacity and material witnesses are revalidated before publication.

path.description: Runtime additionally enforces a 65536-byte UTF-8 cap before making an owned path copy.

materialEdit.description: Existing source material edit. Omitted gesture phase is a standalone commit. Live source-dependent validation and duplicate property/extension identity checks are mandatory. Material texture transforms and resource bindings are not numeric authoring properties.

materialNumericEdit.description: Null resets the schema default, including omitted/infinite attenuation distance. All numeric inputs must remain finite in binary32. Duplicate property identities and disabling an edited extension are rejected at runtime.

nodeName.description: Runtime additionally validates UTF-8 scalar encoding and a 4096-byte limit; maxLength counts Unicode characters.

nodeReparent.description: One-shot undoable reparent using the existing keep-world policy. Runtime resolves both references and validates parent/physics constraints.

nodeTransform.description: One-shot undoable exact local matrix edit; matrix-level Y-flip and TRS decomposition are not introduced.

nodeAuthoring.description: Node authoring or Make Editable for a linked source. Make Editable clears the scene edit history. A duplicate may omit name to use the old label plus ' copy'. Runtime resolves imported primitive owners. Use separate events for other scene mutations.

mergeRequest.description: Prepare an additional glTF/GLB import through the shared worker and publish it into the current selected scene using the session import scale. Placement is separate; failures retain the previous scene and history.

affineNodeMatrix.description: Finite binary32-representable column-major affine local matrix. Singular affine bases are allowed here; runtime consumer constraints remain authoritative.

mergePlacement.description: glTF-native column-major affine matrix. Runtime additionally requires a finite determinant with absolute value greater than 1e-12 both before and after binary32 conversion; JSON Schema cannot express determinant arithmetic.
